About Kai Resolve

What is Kai Resolve?

Kai Resolve is the AI support engineer for second-level (tier 2) support in Gleap. Kai Support answers customers as the first level; Kai Resolve investigates the tickets Kai Support cannot answer using the screen recording, logs and click trail captured by the Gleap SDK, account data from connected sources and your code. It answers the customer when the evidence settles the ticket, prepares a coding task for confirmed bugs and escalates open questions to your team with a diagnosis: its classification of the ticket and the evidence behind it.

What is tier 2 support, and can an AI agent do it? [...] Is Kai Resolve root cause analysis software?

For software teams, yes. Kai Resolve is a root cause analysis (RCA) tool for customer-reported issues: it traces the report through the screen recording, the click trail, console and network logs and your code, then classifies it as answerable, bug, feature request, needs more info or inconclusive. A bug is marked confirmed or suspected with a confidence level and evidence that cites the files it read.

What does Kai Resolve need access to? [...] Does Kai Resolve triage bug reports automatically?

Yes. With Analyze bug reports first turned on, every new bug report from the Gleap widget is investigated before it reaches the inbox and arrives classified: answerable, confirmed bug, suspected bug, feature request, needs more info or inconclusive, each with confidence and evidence. Feature requests subscribe the customer to the existing request.

Which plan includes Kai Resolve?

Kai Resolve is included in Gleap Team, $149 per month billed annually ($179 billed monthly), and in Pro and Enterprise. Each investigation is billed by the work it does, about $0.49 on average; a code investigation bills as Kai Code usage, and a run that fails to start is not charged. See pricing for details.

results.title: How Kai decides what to answer | Gleap
results.content:
The question describes a bug. Kai offers a button to report it, pre-filled with a summary. This is on unless you switch off Suggest bug report.
 It's a feature request, or asks whether something exists. Kai offers to submit a feature request. This is off unless you switch on Suggest feature requests, and it needs a plan with the roadmap (Team and up).
 It's support, billing, account, order, refund or cancellation work Kai can't resolve, or the person asks for a human. Kai hands the conversation to your team, but only once you've set up a handover (below). If Kai Resolve is on, it looks first, see Kai Resolve: a second level of support before your team.
